  ex.count = count; h.WriteLocalVariable(0, count)

식: d = 액터–리스너 거리; d ≤ maxVolumeDistance(리스너+0x64) 이면 vol = 1
식: 곡선 1(로그) vol = decayRatio ^ ((d − maxVolDist) / unitDistance(리스너+0x68)); 곡선 2(선형) vol = max(0, 1 − (1 − decayRatio)·(d − maxVolDist)/unitDistance)
식: 우선순위 감소 = −(int)((1 − vol) × maxPriorityReduction(관리자+0x40))
